title: Password reset email never arrives
description: Customers can request a password reset, but the message is not delivered for accounts created before the latest email-template update.

comments.author: Jordan Lee
comments.body: Reproduced with one migrated account. Checking the queue payload next.

title: Invoice PDF shows the previous office address
description: The billing page is correct, but newly generated invoice PDFs still use the address from the retired template.

comments.author: Priya Shah
comments.body: Asked for one affected invoice number so the template path can be confirmed.

title: Mobile menu covers the request search field
description: At widths below 390 pixels, opening the navigation drawer prevents the search input from receiving pointer events.

title: CSV export drops Romanian diacritics
description: Names containing ă, â, î, ș or ț are replaced by question marks when the report is opened in a spreadsheet application.

comments.author: Sam Brooks
comments.body: The API response is UTF-8. The missing BOM appears to be the spreadsheet compatibility issue.

title: Add a compact dark theme to the customer portal
description: A theme switch would help users working in low-light environments. The preference should persist between sessions.

title: Status page link returns a 404
description: The footer still links to the retired status URL instead of the current service-status page.

comments.author: Jordan Lee
comments.body: Footer link updated and verified on desktop and mobile layouts.

title: Reassignment sends two notification emails
description: Moving a request from one owner to another triggers both the old and new notification handlers.

comments.author: Priya Shah
comments.body: Removed the duplicate event subscription and added a regression check.

title: Attachment upload stops at five megabytes
description: The form advertises a ten-megabyte limit, but uploads between five and ten megabytes fail before reaching the API.
